msg: @sendgrid/* package. Resend: npm i resend, then import { Resend } from 'resend'.
sendgrid Python package. Resend: pip install resend, import resend, set resend.api_key.
SendGrid client setup. Resend: const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY).
SENDGRID_API_KEY holds an SG. key that Resend rejects. Resend: RESEND_API_KEY with a re_ key.
Raw SendGrid v3 endpoint. Resend: POST https://api.resend.com/emails with a flat {from, to, subject, html} body.
sendMultiple does not exist on Resend. Resend: resend.batch.send([...]) with up to 100 emails per call.
personalizations has no Resend field. Resend: one email object per recipient in resend.batch.send (up to 100 per call, up to 50 addresses in to).
SendGrid dynamic template id (d-...) exists only in your SendGrid account. Resend: rebuild the template on Resend or send rendered html/react.
Handlebars template data for a SendGrid template. Resend: render the values into html (or react) before resend.emails.send.
sendAt (Unix seconds) is SendGrid-only. Resend reads scheduledAt, an ISO 8601 string, not sendAt.
Hard-coded send time {ts} is already before {today}. Build scheduledAt from the send moment as an ISO 8601 string.
categories / customArgs are SendGrid-only. Resend: tags: [{ name, value }] (ASCII letters, numbers, _ and -).
Unsubscribe group (asm) has no field in resend.emails.send; the group is dropped. Keep your own suppression list before sending.
Per-message tracking settings. Resend: open and click tracking are switched per domain, not per email; this block is dropped.
sandboxMode has no Resend field, so the email is really sent. Resend: send tests to delivered@resend.dev instead.
ipPoolName has no field in resend.emails.send; the pool choice is dropped.
SendGrid Event Webhook signature check. Resend signs webhooks with Svix: verify svix-id, svix-timestamp and svix-signature headers.
SendGrid event '{ev}' never arrives from Resend: the field is type, not event. Resend: {to}.

map.dropped: no email.* event with this name; handle email.bounced
map.unsubscribe: no email.* event with this name; keep your own unsubscribe list
map.group_unsubscribe: no email.* event with this name; keep your own unsubscribe list
map.group_resubscribe: no email.* event with this name; keep your own unsubscribe list
